name: web-games

scripts.//gate: BUILD FIRST. The route generator writes src/routeTree.gen.ts during the build, and router.tsx imports it — so a typecheck ahead of the build fails on a fresh checkout with an error that is not real. Build is also the honest gate for a structural change, where a green tsc proves nothing.
scripts.gate: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test

//deps: The root holds ONLY what runs ACROSS the tree. A dependency parked here that one app needs is how versions silently drift: both apps resolve it, only one declares it, and bumping it for one bumps it for both. Everything else lives in apps/*/package.json.
